authority: the R136 directions dir 1 (the verified constraint-blind finding) + Art. 9 (the instrument change is a typed amendment, never silent)

the_instrument_change.v1_baseline_arm: build_pair_prompt AS IS at 1613e109a (the constraint text withheld; the C-axis scored blind) — the R134/R135 tallies stand as the v1 baseline, byte-untouched
the_instrument_change.v2_arm: ONE added line in the problem-facts block: 'USER'S CONSTRAINT (a stated requirement): <constraint>' whenever the problem carries a constraint field; the C-axis rubric line unchanged (it already says 'every stated user constraint'); the CoT suffix unchanged; the forced-choice unchanged; the r9 parity order unchanged; the swap-robust rule unchanged
the_instrument_change.what_v2_is_NOT: not a label change, not a bar change, not a prompt re-weighting — the judge is given the SAME information the labeler had (the audit's own framing: 'judges are not shown the information that decides those items')

the_run.corpus: the SAME frozen 10 r5 pairs (audit-branch bytes, labels UNTOUCHED — dev-fu-001 GROUNDED stands; the auditor's 20-30 new labels are auditor-owned and absent on the audit branch; when they land, the v2 instrument re-runs on them)
the_run.judges: the judges with clean transports under the streaming lane: hy4-flash:free (cent-ai SSE, the R135 transport) + dsr1 + qw32b + qwen235b + dsv32 + llama4mav (HF router, streamed where the 504 class hit) — 6 judges x 10 pairs x 2 orders = 120 legs max; byte-resume; the 504/missing legs from R134 retried under streaming FIRST
the_run.gate: UNCHANGED per-judge bar: acc>=0.8 AND answered>=0.9 (the FIXED expected-legs denominator); the panel bar >=3 qualified from >=2 non-agnes families; agreement>=0.7, kappa>=0.6, AUC>=0.8 — with the NEW >=2-qualified guard (no agreement number reported below it)
the_run.honesty: a typed negative if the fix does not lift any judge to 0.8 — the v1-vs-v2 delta table (same judges, same labels, same rule; the only changed variable the constraint line) either way

the_expected_reading: the audit's hypothesis: dev-fu-005 (a1 C=3 vs baseline C=1) and eval-new01 (feasibility+compliance) become decidable when the constraint is shown; if the 0.7 cap is an information artifact, v2 lifts it; if it is a deeper blind spot, the typed negative stands with the per-pair diff as the diagnosis
frozen_before_any_leg: the v2 prompt bytes (the constraint line's exact wording, engine prompts.py)
the r5 labels + gold set (audit-branch bytes)
the fixed denominators (expected legs; the >=2-qualified guard)
